title: The Bell in the Orchard
description: Every autumn the old bell rings once, and nobody will say who rings it. Pira decides this is the year she finds out.

title: Soup for a Hundred Neighbours
description: Gran's pot holds eight bowls. The street holds a hundred people, and the storm is not stopping.

title: What the Tide Left
description: A list of everything one beach gave back over a single winter: nine boots, a door, and one message nobody expected to answer.
